philosophy.core: Design not for utility, but for desire. Every pixel must justify its existence.

layout.grid_philosophy: DERIVED FROM REFERENCE. If the reference is chaotic, be chaotic. If it is rigid, be rigid. Do not use a default system.
layout.whitespace: MATCH REFERENCE DENSITY. If the reference uses 50% whitespace, you use 50%.

typography.headline_display: MATCH REFERENCE VIBE. Use Serif if reference is Elegant. Use Mono if reference is Tech. Use Sans if reference is Modern.
typography.headline_functional: font-sans font-light text-2xl md:text-4xl tracking-normal text-neutral-900
typography.body: font-sans text-sm md:text-base text-neutral-600 leading-[1.8] max-w-[60ch]

motion.scroll_trigger: Elements must reveal themselves slowly on scroll (Fade + Y-Axis Slide).

button.style: MATCH REFERENCE. If reference has pill buttons, use pill. If rectangular, use rectangular.
button.hover_effect: Make it alive. Scale, Color Swap, or Fill.

input.base: w-full bg-transparent border-b border-black/10 py-6 text-xl font-light text-black placeholder-neutral-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-black transition-all duration-500
input.label: uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest text-neutral-400 mb-2 block

image.effect: MATCH REFERENCE. Zoom, Parallax, or grayscale toggle.
